notes.title: Steam Summer Sales 15% Discount and Patch 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

One weeks has passed since the [b]release of Summertime Madness[/b] and it has been a really busy yet exciting week for us! There's a bunch of news, so let's go over check them out:

[h1]Summer Sales : 15% discount until July 8th[/h1]

To celebrate the Summer Sales we decided to keep Summertime Madness on sale at a -15% discounted price! The game will remain at a discounted rate for another two weeks! 
If you haven't done it yet, this is a good chance to check it out :)


[h1]Patch 1.2 is out![/h1]
Patch 1.2 is now out and it includes some major and minor quality of life changes, which are:

[h2]Final Puzzles Rework[/h2]

*SPOILER ALERT*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/4a235b0997215a39364da158abced571f0d46b02.jpg[/img]


The [b]Time Void[/b] has been completely reworked, introducing new elements to the game mechanics and, above all, [i][b]completely removing the 15 minutes limitation. [/b][/i]
This initial choice turned out to be very unwelcome, especially from a those who (rightly) had arrived there with a lot of time available.
Problem solved.
Now you will have all the time you saved up to there, but ...watch out!
I'm sure I heard a strange noise of something ticking and black holes somewhere....

[b]The Twisted Corridor[/b] solution has also been reworked.
It was way too cryptic and we saw very few players getting it.
It is now reworked as well in a new cool fashion, which we hope will more fun (and smart) to play with.


[h2]Memories From The Future Updates. [/h2]
Memories from the Future  turned out to be a part of the game where players were too stressed.
To remedy this, we are still making fine tuning to the area, adding now CLEAR INDICATIONS of where the gates are both in the actual Neo Prague and on the Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/cc22ae0e5071f9218838fe48e4843e45ee9c6e7d.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/7a7197b3c8970a483a24a13d418ad587e40ee250.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/e12978defc0dcf8118aeebc7d85e9cb77b6281ba.jpg[/img]


[h2]Minor bug fix[/h2]
Minor bug fix and small flaws have been polished up.
Among the most important adjustments we have solved an issue for which, after an eventual [b]GAME OVER[/b], the in game clock was no longer usable until a complete restart of the game.
Problem is now solved.

As final note,
the DEMO of Summertime Madness has now been removed.
A demo should be a showcase of what the full experience is, but there have been so many changes, improvements, major bug fix and complete level rework over the last 6 months to the point that this old DEMO is far below the quality of the full game.

Once again, all of your feedbacks were really useful for us, and your suggestions are helping us to make Summertime Madness a better gaming experience day after day.

DP Games will remain active and in touch with all those who will continue to leave their comments, ready to further improve the quality of your experience.

Have fun,
and happy Summer Sale!

DP Games

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out! No Time-Limit mode available, UI Crosshair, Puzzle Rework.
notes.notes:
Greetings!

These first two days since the [b]release of Summertime Madness[/b] have been great (and intense!)
We are excited about how things are going and we have carefully monitored all the initial feedback you had for us. 

For this reason, the [b]first official patch[/b] is now live!
It includes some quality of life changes, which are:

[h2]No Time Limit Mode available from the start![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/ae071c06243f290e54e30f9bfbb06686bf163ce1.jpg[/img]
You can now play the Explorer mode [i][b](timeless)[/b][/i] mode since [b]the first time you play the game[/b], no need to unlock it anymore!

[h2]Crosshair Option[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/838f8b65313656467b30dbcd5ad07b0a168d52d1.jpg[/img]
There is now a crosshair, that you can tune in the [i]Player Settings menu[/i]. 
This might help some users with motion sickness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340145/c7aaf62fc8cd73a2201f1a455069fafbe712310a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Memories from the Future : Autosave upgrade[/h2]
*SPOILER ALERT*
Memories from the Future  turned out to be a part of the game where players were too stressed.
To remedy this, the game will now a[b]utomatically save your progress when you unlock Gates I and II[/b], allowing you to take a break and start over exactly where you left off without having to solve the same puzzles again!


We really appreciate all the feedbacks a lot, all your suggestions are helping us to make Summertime Madness a better gaming experience, and this is our top priority.

DP Games will remain active and in touch with all those who will continue to leave their comments, ready to further improve the quality of your experience.

Cosimo
Davide

notes.title: Summertime Madness Patch 1.07d : Hint System, Player Settings, Gameplay Update.
notes.notes:
During the last month we have been thrilled to have reached out so many people who have played and tried the Summertime Madness demo we released during the Steam Game Festival last February.

We were delighted by such a warm welcome and the from the many feedback we received, which have been collected and on which we have worked hard during the last month in order to release the first official patch of the Demo.

We sincerely thank all of those who have spent their time to play with us and expressed their opinions and suggestions about Summertime Madness: all this is essential for us to continue to work at our best and provide all of you players with the best possible gaming experience.

Thank you.

Davide
Lead Dev Summertime Madness


SM 1.01d Patch Notes - 10th March 2021

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[i][b]- Hint System introduced :[/b][/i] You can now speak with the Devil and ask for a little help if you got stuck with a puzzle. But be careful: nothing comes for free…

[i][b]- Interactions Hitbox enlarged :[/b][/i] All the hitboxes are now bigger, so it’s easier to check what are the object you can interact with.

[i][b]- Player Movement speed :[/b][/i]  Both the walking and the running speed of the player have been slightly increased.

[i][b]- Camera Field of View [/b][/i]:  The camera has now a larger Field of View and it is also adjustable (read player setting notes).

[i][b]- Colliders adjustments :[/b][/i] Various colliders (walls, floors, furniture) have been edited and adjusted.

[i][b]- Over the Bridge Puzzle Fix :[/b][/i]  The Bridges does not resets anymore after the player falls off through the clouds.



[b]Player Settings[/b]
[i][b]- Mouse Sensitivity slider :[/b][/i]  Mouse sensitivity can now be adjusted according to your preferences.

[i][b]- Camera FoV slider :[/b][/i]  Camera field of view can now be adjusted according to your preferences.

[i][b]- Mouse Axes invert :[/b][/i]  Mouse X axes and Y axes can now be inverted.

[i][b]- Motion Blur :[/b][/i]  Motion Blur is now disabled by default and can be activated on command via player setting options.

[i][b]- Paint Effect :[/b][/i] Painterly effect can now be lowered/increased via menu.



[b]UI and Menus[/b]
[i][b]- Menu Font :[/b][/i]  The font used in the various game menus has been unified.

[i][b]- Achievements Menu :[/b][/i] The Achievements menu is now accessible in the in-game menu.

[i][b]- Menu Animations :[/b][/i] Minor animations/colors are added to the menu in order to make it easier to navigate.

[i][b]- Cursor size :[/b][/i] The cursor size now scales accordingly to the resolution selected.



[i][b]Localization[/b][/i]
- Adjustments to the Russian, French and Deutsche translations have been made.
